title.zh: SmartLingo V2 第七轮补丁：横屏场景词卡不再裁切
title.en: SmartLingo V2 round seven follow-up: prevent landscape word-card clipping

purpose.zh: 修复正式站验收时发现的横屏词卡内容贴近圆角边缘而被裁切的问题，同时保持提示和操作同屏。
purpose.en: Fix word-card content clipped by rounded stage edges in production landscape acceptance while keeping instructions and actions in one viewport.

zh: 在现有横屏播放器中收紧词图、词义和间距，词卡全文保留在舞台圆角安全区域。
新增 WebKit 场景文字上下内边距断言，防止以后只满足操作按钮同屏却裁切教学内容。
en: Tighten the picture, meaning, and spacing within the existing landscape player so the complete word card remains inside the rounded stage safe area.
Add WebKit assertions for scene-copy top and bottom insets, preventing future one-screen action layouts from clipping lesson content.

zh: 仅影响生活口语的横屏播放器及其布局检查；不改变课程顺序、价格、会员权限、成绩或支付。
en: Affects only the landscape Everyday Speaking player and layout gate; lesson order, prices, entitlements, scores, and checkout remain unchanged.

zh: 修改现有播放器 CSS 的横屏排版，并让现有 WebKit 布局采集器检查词卡相对舞台边界的实测位置。
en: Adjust existing player landscape CSS and make the existing WebKit collector measure word-card placement against stage edges.

zh: 完整测试、TypeScript、零警告 lint、生产构建、敏感信息扫描及 WebKit 中英多尺寸布局检查作为发布门槛；部署后在生产 Chrome 点击开始，核对词卡全文和按钮。
en: Full tests, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, production build, sensitive-data scan, and bilingual WebKit viewport checks gate release; click Start in production Chrome afterward to verify full word card and controls.

zh: Max 角色导师仍独立关闭，待普通付费测试用户的真实端到端验收；尚未审核的语言对话继续显示内容不可用，而不会教错误翻译。
en: The Max role tutor remains independently gated until real ordinary paid-member acceptance. Unreviewed language dialogues continue to show unavailable content rather than teaching mismatched translations.

zh: 这是 SmartLingo 专属教学编排改进，复用本地生活口语组卡、播放器与测试，不迁移其他站点代码或数据。
en: This is SmartLingo-specific lesson sequencing, reusing its local deck builder, player, and tests without migrating another site's code or data.

rollback.zh: 如需回退，可恢复上一成功提交；旧进度 Cookie 与新版键分离，不必修改数据库。
rollback.en: Revert to the prior successful commit if needed. The prior progress cookie remains separate from the versioned key; no database rollback is required.
